text:
Lina: Quick sync 8 AWS Marketplace + NovaSystems SI planning joint launch. Need clear rules for lead stamping and handoffs.
Raj: Yep. Main question: when does Nova own vs Redwood own?
Emma: Draft rule: Nova owns if (1) account ARR >= $100k or marked strategic AND (2) Nova executed pre-sales intro/co-demo.
Mike: How do we reliably record pre-sales intros? SFDC field is flaky.
Alex: Enforce tag `partner:novasys-intro` + require a meeting event within 30d. Automation can flag missing evidence.
Sarah-W: Also: if lead_source contains `aws-marketplace` and Nova triaged it via intake, Nova gets primary routing.
Lina: So signals: intro-tag, marketplace-origin+triage, high-value. Which has precedence?
Raj: Precedence: intro-tag > marketplace+triage > high-value. If Nova did the heavy lift, they should keep it.
Emma: Add protection: if Redwood is in deal stage >= Proposal, do not auto-reassign without SDR+AE sync.
Mike: I can make a compact decision matrix for the intake UI.
Alex: Automation sketch:
```
if has_tag('partner:novasys-intro') && meeting_with_partner_within(30d): owner = Nova
else if lead_source == 'aws-marketplace' && partner_triaged == true: owner = Nova
else if ARR >= 100000 && not in_deal_stage('proposal','contract'): owner = Nova
else: owner = Redwood
```
Sarah-W: Exception: if NAMED=true (Redwood named account), do NOT auto-assign to Nova unless sales exec approves.
Lina: Dispute flow?
Raj: Steps: (1) add `dispute:open` tag + DM partner ops SME, (2) 24hr SLA, (3) unresolved -> weekly handoff review meeting.
partnerships-bot: will post new disputes to #partnerships-disputes and set `dispute:open` in CRM. :robot_face:
Emma: Joint-announce/press accounts = manual review only (GTM + legal).
Mike: Implementation asks: intake API should expose `partner_triaged` (bool) and `partner_intro_tag` (string), plus webhook on marketplace utm.
Alex: I'll open the intake PR with SFDC mapping (tag -> custom field) and example webhook.
Lina: Timeline: PR by Tue, automation rules in staging by Fri, playbook draft by EOD Fri. Who owns playbook?
Sarah-W: I'll own the playbook draft (templates + handshake steps).
Raj: I'll confirm expectations with Nova and AWS PMs.
Emma: Include an email intro boilerplate so tag step isn't missed.
Lina: Any objections? If none, we pilot on the marketplace launch.
Mike: No objections.
Alex: 44d
Sarah-W: All good.
Raj: No objections, will surface partner feedback if needed.
Lina: Locked. I'll upload the playbook and ping when PR is ready. :tada:
